title: SPF decoded
caption: SPF numbers measure how much UVB a sunscreen blocks — but in Dubai, UVA is the bigger daily threat: it drives pigmentation, breaks down collagen, and cuts straight through car windows and tinted glass. A high SPF number alone doesn't tell you UVA is covered. Look for 'broad-spectrum' on the label, or a PA+++ rating, to know both wavelengths are addressed. In Gulf humidity, formulation also matters: a sunscreen you'll actually re-apply every two hours beats a perfect formula you stop wearing by noon. Not medical advice, just the honest basics.
